result.summary: FAIL. Structure OK: «## Что нашли (проверено 2026-09-29)» (line 15), «## Где искали» (line 294), conclusion markers (lines 355/433); every price/competitor/market-size fact has a link. 36 links opened across sections 1-7; 34 confirm the file. BLOCKING F1 (lines 230-232, section 6 «Казахстан/СНГ»): «готовность CEO к ИИ-трансформации — 29%» is not a Kazakhstan figure. profit.kz (section «Вызов для всех») gives it as Gartner analyst Arup Roy's global statistic («Задача ... носит мировой масштаб ... лишь 29% считают свои компании готовыми к конкуренции»), so the market mark is wrong and the link does not say what the file claims. The same line says the «Agents Versus Humans» session was held «с участием Kaspi, Казахтелекома, Bank RBK». The article says the session was top managers and business owners working in teams; Kaspi, Kazakhtelecom and Bank RBK appear in the panels and awards, not in that session. Fix: mark the 29% [мир], Gartner via [СМИ], and describe the session as the article does. REQUIRED F2 (vendor vs independent, per market-researcher mandate and the file's own legend): source-type marks are inconsistent. Section 2: Dash0 and Torii are marked [вендор] but Datadog Agent Console, AWS CloudWatch, Jellyfish and Omnara (vendors' own pages) are not. The section 7 table has no marks. Most section 6 facts (EY, zakon.kz, mybuh.kz, kapital.kz/KPMG, kursiv, profit.kz, digitalbusiness.kz, timesca, trend.az, habr) are unmarked. CORRECTIONS: F3 line 23: LangSmith «Enterprise ... хранение до 400 дней» is wrong. The page gives 400 days for extended traces on every plan (a paid upgrade) and 14 days for base traces; Enterprise retention is not stated. F4 lines 45-46: Helicone «только исправления и обновления безопасности». The page says «security updates, new models, bug & performance fixes all keep shipping». F5 line 284: the date «не позднее 18.05.2026» comes from a secondary source; the claude.com post itself has datePublished May 11, 2026. F6 line 218: the file says «70+ компаний Центральной Азии и Кавказа»; the article says «более 70 компаний и 2 500 технологических руководителей по всему миру», so quote it as written. F7 lines 105 and 118-119: interpretation outside the conclusion markers: «Техническая основа, общая для всех перечисленных» (not shown for Torii/Jellyfish/Omnara/PixelHQ) and «расходятся в разы, потому что у отчётов разные границы рынка». Move these into the conclusion region or reword them as facts. F8 line 136: Pew is a US-only survey but sits under «мир»; mark it [США].
